##### Network FFRCISTG

The network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (NFFRCISTG) is a causal model of an NPSEM that satisfies (1) no contagion, (2) homogeneous network interference with respect to a known set of network graphs, (3) identical structural distributions and (4) single-world independence (@def-nffrcistg). It replaces the FFRCISTG's no interference with homogeneous network interference.
